Here are today’s headlines – the latest news in the Philippines and around the world:

items: PH peso reaches new all time low

blocks.text: The Philippine peso again falls to a new all-time closing low of P63.36 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday, October 21.

items: De Lima, Diokno, 8 other House lawmakers want China envoy recalled

blocks.text: Ten House lawmakers file a proposed resolution urging President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. to either declare Chinese Ambassador Jing Quan persona non grata or ask Beijing to recall him.
The Supreme Court declares the 2024 and 2025 General Appropriations Acts or budget laws, unconstitutional.

items: France to deploy troops, admits to failures over weekend unrest

blocks.text: France will reinforce police with troops and mount a huge security operation for more protests planned on Saturday.

items: Musk ordered slowdown of Starlink service used by Ukraine’s military – report

blocks.text: Elon Musk reportedly ordered the slowdown of a Starlink satellite service that Ukraine relies on.
